title: Spring + Postgres Compose stack (real-derived from docker/awesome-compose)

source.notes: Base = the upstream (valid) spring-postgres compose.yaml. Three defects injected, each findable within the file: a database-name mismatch, a dangling network, and a dangling secret. The db service's own POSTGRES_DB and network are untouched.

construction.proposer: opus-4.8 (proposed); audited & confirmed 2026-07-05 via oracle audit (validator + anchor-resolution + real/findable/unique pass, docs/oracle-audit-2026-07-05.md) with a targeted human audit of ambiguous/interacting defects and all gray zones (docs/human-audit-checklist)

the db POSTGRES_DB=example is the reference value, untouched

known_gray_zone.note: The top-level secret `db-password` is left unused once d3 renames the db's secret; declared-but-unused, not a seeded defect.
